thread:
mohit: flagging an odd spike in parse failures for the int8 canary rolling last night, seen in the toolcall bench. canary-bot: canary report -> https://infradash/redwood/canaries/17285  spike start ~00:12 UTC, peak ~00:28 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sasha: bleh. any changes to prompts/tokenizer?
mohit: prompts unchanged. quant config: per-layer asym int8 + aggressive act clipping. batching window moved 50ms -> 30ms for the canary pool.
elaine: sample failure from logs:
```
ERROR: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
RESPONSE SNIPPET: "\\u0000\\u0000{\"action\":\"create_ticket\",\"args\":{\"title\":\"...\"}}"
```
leading control bytes (NULs) in a few responses.
derek: NULs usually mean tokenization/encoding mismatch or streaming boundary corruption. did streaming framing change?
mohit: no explicit change. runtime shows slightly higher chunk-size variance after batch tweak.
sasha: could be kvcache + quant interaction. saw similar once before with a different model. quant sometimes nudges first-token distribution causing low-value/control tokens.
elaine: I inspected 30 failing traces: concentrated on short outputs where the JSON starts immediately; model occasionally emits 0x00 or 0x03 before "{".
canary-bot: alert: failure mode=streaming-prefix-noise, model=raven-int8-v3q-canary-17285, rate=3.8%, baseline=0.2%
mohit: propose quick mitigations:
- rollback batch-window to 50ms on canary pool (temp)
- deploy a streaming scrub that strips leading control chars before parse
- enable token-level logging on 1% sample for boundary traces
- run kv-cache on vs off microbench for same prompts
sasha: scrub seems fine as short mitigation. keep it idempotent and cheap: regex drop leading control chars (<= 0x1F) pre-parse.
derek: scrub for now but we need root cause: add test in onboarding harness that checks for non-printable prefixes across N samples for quant candidates.
elaine: I'll open the scrub PR and patch runtime to capture raw vs cleaned outputs for auditing.
mohit: who can run the kv bench? sasha?
sasha: on it. running 10k calls comparing kv on vs off for int8 canary and fp16 baseline. early note: int8 shows slight shift towards low-value first tokens. full results ETA EOD PST.
derek: if kv amplifies pattern we might need a noop guard token early in streams for quant models.
mohit: timeline: rollback now, scrub deploy in ~30m, kv microbench in parallel, follow up 9:30am PT with results.
elaine: scrub PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/7421 includes unit test that strips NULs and other control chars before json parse.
canary-bot: scrub deploy started on canary pool commit=a1b2c3 est=5m
sasha: kv microbench early logs: higher entropy in first-token distribution for int8 under current encoding table -> slight bump toward controlchar tokens. full run in progress.
mohit: good work. once we have bench + scrub metrics we'll convert to a concise postmortem and add a gating check: structured-output-parse-fail-rate <= baseline + 0.5% for quant onboarding. :thumbsup:
